---
name: review-hierarchy-and-trust
description: Review competing actions and supporting evidence for a specific claim.
---

Use DIFF-007 and 008. Ask which action matters on this page if the goal is unknown. Inspect alternatives in the same decision area. For trust, map a single claim to evidence that supports that claim. Count nearby unrelated logos as a look-alike case. Write the measured observation first. Record impact on attention or trust as a hypothesis. Prefer the existing UX, Conversion or Trust repair group when it owns the same fix.
